Protection
Drive over-temperature protection: Protection temperature: 120°C. The motor will exit "enable mode" if over-temperature occurs.
Motor over-temperature protection: Set according to usage requirements; it is recommended not to exceed 100°C (setting over 110°C may burn the coils). The motor will exit "enable mode" if over-temperature occurs.
Motor over-voltage protection: Set according to usage requirements; factory default is 60V, maximum setting cannot exceed 65V. It will exit "enable mode" if over-voltage occurs.
Communication loss protection: If no CAN command is received within the set period, it will automatically exit "enable mode".
The motor will exit enable mode if continuous stalling occurs.
Motor over-current protection: Set according to usage requirements; it is recommended not to exceed 0.98. It will exit "enable mode" if over-current occurs.
Motor under-voltage protection: If the supply voltage is lower than the set value, it will exit "enable mode". The supply voltage should not be lower than 20V.

Each wrist-mounted Insight 3 module weighs only 158 g. The two hand cameras capture UMI close-range hand interactions, complementing the ego view with fine-grained manipulation data.

128 GB NVMe SSD (Standard)
V-Mount Battery
The backpack unit weighs approximately 1.8 kg and integrates edge computing, local storage, and mobile power. It runs the acquisition program and stores ROS 2 bags, RGB-D, IMU, VIO pose, calibration parameters, and task metadata. Local storage can be upgraded based on recording duration and data-volume requirements. The battery supports approximately 150–170 minutes of continuous real-world data capture.

Ubuntu + ROS 2 Data Acquisition Software
Provides unified device connection, recording control, acquisition-status management, data-directory organization, clip management, and a post-processing workflow.

Motor over-temperature protection: Can be set according to usage requirements. It is recommended not to exceed 100°C (setting above 110°C may burn the coil). The motor will exit "Enable Mode" when over-temperature occurs.
Motor over-voltage protection: Can be set according to usage requirements. It is recommended not to exceed 65V. The motor will exit "Enable Mode" when over-voltage occurs.

Motor over-current protection: Can be set according to usage requirements. It is recommended not to exceed 0.98. The motor will exit "Enable Mode" when over-current occurs.
